detectionMethod.mergePolicy: contiguous question-segments merged into runs with up to 1 bridging non-question segment (ASR micro-split tolerance, capped at span_len 20)
detectionMethod.worksheetExpansion: runs falling inside a worksheet-reading block (teacher reading prompt from slide) are expanded to the full contiguous worksheet-reading segment range

exclusionRules.A_bare_confirmation_tag: text is just a confirmation tag (是嗎/對嗎/對不對/是不是/這樣可以嗎) with no recoverable question content
exclusionRules.B_declarative_false_positive: segment contains a wh-word but is syntactically declarative (no ？/? and no terminal question particle)
exclusionRules.C_incomplete_asr_fragment: segment begins a question but is cut off mid-clause without a terminal question cue
exclusionRules.D_short_rhetorical: short rhetorical phrase that adds no TOC value
exclusionRules.E_meta_narration: meta-comment about asking a question without stating one
